relevance_check_relevance_tips.message:
Relevance is calculated based on the ASIN’s exact positions within the top 96 organic search results for a given keyword.
(We capture the top 2 pages for layouts displaying 48 products per page, or the top 6 pages for layouts showing 16 products per page.)
High Relevance: ≥ {high}%
Medium Relevance: {medium}%–{high}%
Low Relevance: {low}%–{medium}%
Irrelevant: < {low}%
How Relevance is Calculated: Click here

relevance_check_keyword_performance_scor.message:
The Keyword Performance Score (also called Z-score) is calculated using the Z-score formula to evaluate how a keyword performs relative to the average of all queried keywords:
Positive value: Keyword performs above average; higher = better
Negative value: Keyword performs below average; lower = worse
0: Keyword is around average performance
How the Keyword Performance Score is Calculated: Click here
